flags.message: Forward-signal disclosure: the forecast leans on West Virginia v. B.P.J. (No. 24-43) having been decided 2026-06-30 — the same day as this docket's CVSG and one day inside the snapshot cutoff — retrieved via CourtListener MCP. Legitimate pre-snapshot public information, disclosed because it was decisive for reading the CVSG as a plenary-interest signal rather than a prelude to GVR. B.P.J.'s opinion text was not available on CourtListener at run time, so only its existence and timing were used.
